invitation.youAreInvited: You are invited to the wedding of

items.title: Ceremony
items.description: Let's celebrate the union of two souls

venues.name: Motsameta Monastery
venues.description: The ceremony will take place at the beautiful historic Motsameta Monastery.

venues.name: Chateau Vartsike
venues.description: Reception, dinner, and celebrations will be held at the elegant Chateau Vartsike.

items.question: What is the dress code?
items.answer: The dress code is formal. We suggest dark suits or evening gowns.

items.question: Can I bring a guest?
items.answer: Please refer to your invitation. If you have a plus one, it will be indicated on your invitation card.

items.question: What time should I arrive?
items.answer: Please arrive 15 minutes before the ceremony starts. The ceremony begins at 5:00 PM.

items.question: Is there parking available?
items.answer: Yes, free parking is available at the venue. Valet parking will also be provided.

items.question: When does the fight start?
items.answer: Unfortunately, the wedding program does not include a fight.

items.question: What should I gift?
items.answer: No specific gifts are required. Your presence and love are enough. In case of a monetary gift, please use the bank accounts provided below.

table.title: Find Your Table
table.note: Please note that the table layout may change. The final layout will be available on-site.
table.comingSoon: Coming soon, thank you for your patience!

footer.text: Thank you for celebrating with us

dressCode.title: Dress Code
dressCode.rule1: Do NOT wear white - white is reserved for the bride
dressCode.rule2: Avoid white mixed with other colors or patterns
dressCode.rule3: Purple is for the bride's side close relatives and family - you can wear it too!
dressCode.rule4: Green is the groom's favorite color - you are welcome to wear it!
dressCode.rule5: Dress comfortably and formally - aim for elegant and sophisticated style
dressCode.rule6: The weather is expected to be pleasant, but bring a jacket just in case
dressCode.rule7: Respect the formal dress code - avoid casual attire
